title: I'd rather do it after we eat dinner.
scene: 叫他练某样，他用偏好推后，并提出替代。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Let's practice counting together for a little while.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I'd rather do it after we eat dinner.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You said that same thing yesterday, too.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Not now, please — my brain is too full.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: What is your brain full of, then?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: It is full of all the playing I did today.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You can play for ten more minutes, and then we will count.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Can I count the blocks that I built?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: That is a great idea, it works for me.
